summary: Multi-stage teardown for an on-screen overlay object. Releases the two sub-resource pointers held at dword indices 6 and 7 (offsets 0x18, 0x1C) and the three linked-list pointers at indices 1-3 (offsets 0x4, 0x8, 0xC) when non-null, then runs a four-phase cleanup sequence (ShortComputation_ec40, SoundResourceCleanup, SingleFieldFreeWrapper, ConditionalFreeSubCall) on five sub-blocks addressed by dword offsets 24/43/62/81/100 relative to this. Finally zeroes the byte flag at 0x0 and all DWORD fields 0x4..0x5C, returning 0.

operations.description: If the pointer at dword index 6 (offset 0x18) is non-null, release it via sub_53CB90 and clear the field.
If the pointer at dword index 7 (offset 0x1C) is non-null, release it via sub_53CB90 and clear the field.
If the pointer at dword index 1 (offset 0x4) is non-null, run StringCompareLinkedListSearch on it and clear the field.
If the pointer at dword index 2 (offset 0x8) is non-null, run StringCompareLinkedListSearch on it and clear the field.
If the pointer at dword index 3 (offset 0xC) is non-null, run StringCompareLinkedListSearch on it and clear the field.
Run the four-phase cleanup (ShortComputation_ec40, SoundResourceCleanup, SingleFieldFreeWrapper, ConditionalFreeSubCall) on the sub-block at dword offset 24.
Run the same four-phase cleanup sequence on the sub-block at dword offset 43.
Run the same four-phase cleanup sequence on the sub-block at dword offset 62.
Run the same four-phase cleanup sequence on the sub-block at dword offset 81.
Run the same four-phase cleanup sequence on the sub-block at dword offset 100.
Zero the byte flag at offset 0x0.
Zero the remaining DWORD fields from offset 0x4 through offset 0x5C.
